scope_guards: Current capacity, pupil forecasts and planned places remain distinct.
SCAP forecasts are authority submissions and not guaranteed enrolment or available places.
Pupil planning areas are not school catchments or admission rights.
Developer-funded forecasts are not executed Section 106 payments or completed classrooms.
Temporary and permanent provision remain distinct.
Mainstream, specialist and SEND capacity are not substituted for each other.
Capital allocations are not candidate-specific school projects or opening dates.
Exact pupil yield, planning area, agreement, funded project and delivery evidence is required.
